 Sunil Mittal, founder of India's second-largest telco Airtel, says Airtel-backed OneWeb can build a satellite-internet network independent of the US and China   —  Indian billionaire Sunil Bharti Mittal is betting he can build a global satellite-internet network independent of both the US and China …
